Python — Devices and Networks

Reconstructor-type and internal-temperature queries are available only on camera models and firmware that provide those APIs. Unsupported operations return a failure result.

Correspond device.py And version slows in.

API Reference

get_sdk_version()

Purpose: Read SDK Package version, do not connect the camera.

Parameters: None

Returns: str.

get_info(ip)

Purpose: Read the camera identity, version, network, model and default image size.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

Returns: EpicEyeInfo dict or None.

get_reconstructor_type(ip)

Purpose: Read camera re-constructor composition.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

Returns: int or None;back when the camera does not support the capability None.

get_temperature_info(ip, use_cache=True)

Purpose: Read camera internal temperature; Cache mode using camera end 60 Second cache.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

use_cache

bool

Whether to use cached data; Default: True.

Returns: dict or None.

search_camera()

Purpose: Searches for cameras on the current network and returns the result.

Parameters: None

Returns: list[dict] or None.

start_discovery() / stop_discovery()

Purpose: Start/Stop the backstage and continue to find out.

Parameters: None

Returns: None.

get_discovered_cameras()

Purpose: Returns the current discovered camera list.

Parameters: None

Returns: list[dict].

clear_discovered_cameras()

Purpose: Clears the current camera list. Online cameras are added again when rediscovered.

Parameters: None

Returns: None.

set_discovery_callback(callback)

Purpose: Registers a callback for camera-list changes. Read the latest list in the callback.

Parameters

Name Type Description

callback

Optional[Callable[[], None]]

Callback invoked when the device list changes.

Returns: None.

get_epiceye_version(ip)

Purpose: Read SDK Recorded version of camera service; no active connection to camera.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

Returns: Optional[str].

clear_epiceye_version_cache(ip=None)

Purpose: Clears the records of the specified camera or all service versions.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

Optional[str]

Camera address; Default: None.

Returns: None.

set_epiceye_ip_config(…​)

Purpose: Offset DHCP Or static. IP Configure. The operation is used UDP, does not return the equipment confirmation results.

Parameters

Name Type Description

ip

str

Camera address.

new_ip

str

Value of new_ip; Default: None.

netmask

str

Value of netmask; Default: '255.255.255.0'.

ip_type

str

Value of ip_type; Default: 'DHCP'.

sn

str

Value of sn; Default: 'IMPOSSIBLE_SERIAL_NUMBER'.

Returns: bool, which indicates that the request for configuration has been sent.

search_camera() returns one search result. Use start_discovery(), get_discovered_cameras(), the discovery callback, and stop_discovery() when the camera list must be updated continuously.

Example: Continuous Discovery

import epiceye

def on_changed():
    for camera in epiceye.get_discovered_cameras():
        print(camera["ip"], camera["sn"], camera["model"])

epiceye.set_discovery_callback(on_changed)
epiceye.start_discovery()
input("Press Enter Stop Discovery\n")
epiceye.stop_discovery()
epiceye.set_discovery_callback(None)
